question: Do the documented source identities, treatment arms, units and endpoint formats support the gorby extension specified in the owning plan?
decision: Qualify finite source description for Gorby, or identify whether the exact proposed interaction comparison has a usable public source.
strongest_rival: Keyword matches, inconsistent replicate labels, duplicated control columns or shared source reuse can falsely imply a matched biological comparison.
discriminator: Exact workbook/GEO joins and source-format checks for Gorby; retained query results and source-specific design dispositions for interaction screens. No gene effects.
exposure_record: Saxton/Gorby published results, Saxton source results, worksheet header/dimensions and public metadata were inspected before freeze. Gorby target abundance contrasts have not been inspected; this remains exposed source qualification.
biological_unit: Public sample metadata and matrix records; author-reported donors and source blocks are distinguished from independently verified identities.
nesting_and_overlap: Queries overlap and SuperSeries/subseries are not independent. Repeated worksheet control columns are copies, not new samples. Cross-study donor overlap is unresolved.
population_and_selection: Exactly the recorded queries and their complete returned records, or the full deposited CD8 workbook and its 21 source columns; no outcome selection.
contrast: Source eligibility against the prewritten extension tuple; not a biological treatment-effect contrast.
endpoint: Sample/column identity, matrix schema, target mapping and interpretation limits, or source-by-source eligibility and missing design factors.
methods: Read saved hashed GEO SOFT/JSON and openpyxl workbook. Validate all repeated normalized control values without computing gene effects. Screen decisions are explicit reviewed metadata annotations.
missingness_and_exclusions: All hits retained. Unknown units and missing arms remain explicit; stop on truncated searches or unreviewed records. No target replacement or invented arm.
multiplicity: No statistical tests; metadata qualification only.
precision_basis: Source intake estimates no population quantity or uncertainty; donor/endpoint qualification is the deliverable.
interpretation_limit: Metadata eligibility is not biological acceptance, statistical independence, signaling, secretion or interaction evidence.
stop_rule: Stop on schema/hash mismatch or missing query records; report absent/ambiguous targets and invalid source values rather than repairing silently.
amendment_reason: Initial prospective metadata stage authorized after literature-grounded extension planning; all prior frozen analyses retained.
